name: Section row
description: The For Each template for a lesson's sections: one row is { id, section, conceptId, facts, copy }, and the kit's Section node renders the section by its kind and draws the knot. Its root IS the kit node, so each row lands as a direct child of the lesson grid (the Sprint-8 fragment contract). A row that carries a concept SAVES what the learner captures, through the `capture` function, and the kit shows ✓ only when that answers (TASK-L177).
